text:
Sofia M.: Quick question after last week's Edinburgh visit. My Airbnb host canceled 24h before arrival and I had to book a last-minute hotel (Deluxe Inn) at higher rate. Company card declined during the booking so I paid EUR 230 on personal card and the portal shows a separate corporate charge of EUR 40 for the concierge breakfast later. Also I grabbed a few taxis (small cash fares) and lost one receipt.
Sofia M.: Questions: 1) Is last-minute hotel ok to claim and any pre-approval needed retro? 2) How do I submit split charges (personal + company card)? 3) Missing taxi receipt for ~GBP 6 — what's acceptable? 4) Per-diem: I arrived late evening, do I get full night?
travel-bot: Reminder: attach host cancellation screenshot, hotel folio, boarding pass, corporate card decline screenshot, and any receipts. Max 10MB per file.
People Ops (Nina): Short answers: 1) Last-minute rebook due to host cancellation is reimbursable. Retro approvals accepted; include host cancellation notice. 2) Submit two expense lines: hotel_personal and hotel_company (if corporate posted any charges). Tag both with same PNR/ref and note "split payment". 3) For lost taxi receipt, provide taxi time, pickup/drop streets and manager attestation in notes; Finance accepts attestation for small fares (<GBP10). 4) Per-diem: overnight stayed in destination = full per-diem. Late arrival but stayed overnight counts.
Finance Team: Portal guidance (copy/paste):
```
expense_type: hotel_last_minute
amount: 230.00
currency: EUR
merchant: Deluxe Inn Edinburgh
date: 2026-06-03
payment_method: personal_card
attachments: host_cancellation_screenshot.jpg, hotel_folio.pdf, card_decline.png
note: Airbnb canceled 2026-06-02 (attach notice). Split payment: corporate charged concierge meal EUR 40 (see separate line). PNR: EDN-4421
```
Finance Team: Separate corporate line example:
```
expense_type: hotel_incidental
amount: 40.00
currency: EUR
merchant: Deluxe Inn Edinburgh
date: 2026-06-04
payment_method: company_card
attachments: hotel_folio.pdf
note: corporate charge for breakfast charged by hotel after check-out; related to same stay PNR EDN-4421
```
Finance Team: Missing taxi receipt: use expense_type: taxi and include manager_attestation: "Manager Carlos confirmed trip" and include pickup/drop details.
Manager (Carlos): Confirmed I saw the cancellation and approved emergency hotel. Adding a brief email now; flag as "manager_approved".
Sofia M.: Thanks — uploading the host message and the hotel folio now. Will add Carlos' email as the manager approval. :thumbsup:
